en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a busy waterfront quay with sailing boats and small ships in the foreground and multi‑story neoclassical and Ottoman‑era buildings lining the promenade in the background. People are visible along the quay. At the top left there is printed bilingual text in French and English describing the view, and a small dome with a clock tower is seen on one of the buildings. The overall style is early 20th‑century.
